approved_contract: Three forward-EMA seeds use 1,500 TRAIN-only six-future-product pretraining updates followed by 1,500 supervised TRAIN updates and final-endpoint checkpoints.
The detached EMA teacher sees only the exact next six TRAIN source products; the online future branch receives gradients only through the fixed variance and covariance regularizers.
The fixed loss is 25 times Smooth L1 prediction loss plus 25 times the mean two-view variance penalty plus one times the mean two-view off-diagonal covariance penalty.
The random-encoder seed-7 control receives no pretraining and only 1,500 learned head updates; its unequal learned-update budget is explicitly disclosed.
The shuffled seed-7 control uses false future targets from distinct TRAIN windows at least 24 source interval IDs apart.
The direct reference remains the immutable three-seed core direct family with 3,000 supervised updates per seed and identical validation support.
The run is explicitly post-hoc development, preserves SOTA claim NOT_ESTABLISHED and uses the corrected eligible-target-source-date evaluator.
The final exact code digest binds the pairer, objective, shared encoder, cohort reader, prediction writer, artifact reader and evaluator.
execution_conditions: Run the five slots serially under the configured device, RAM and GPU-memory gates.
Do not change the config, source, split, pair inventory, evaluator, artifact reader or approved dependency hashes after this review.
Obtain independent post-run checkpoint, prediction, metric, representation-diagnostic and control review before any development selection.
A failed slot may restart the same fixed endpoint recipe; do not tune from partial or validation results.
scientific_limits: This extension was designed after core development evidence and is post-hoc, not a preregistered confirmatory arm.
The main forward family has half the supervised-label update budget of the direct reference; equal total updates do not imply equal labeled supervision.
The anti-collapse loss does not guarantee useful or noncollapsed representations; TRAIN-only rank, variance, covariance and scale diagnostics and validation controls must decide that empirically.
Validation performance cannot establish SOTA, external validity, calibrated absolute backscatter, biological causality or production value.
